evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically from ~6 ppm to 51.5 ppm through growth stage
Tube pressure creeping up 2.98 -> 3.44 Torr at constant Ar setpoint 100 sccm
Ar flow steady at setpoint, so pressure/O2 rise is not from flow change
Temperature control at 750 °C nominal, heater power stable ~43%

args.missing_evidence: Response of P and O2 to a brief Ar flow change or pump-down/valve isolation test (leak-up rate) would confirm air ingress versus exhaust restriction; post-run film characterization.
